headline: Blackline Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates While Revenue Falls Short
summary: Blackline reported third-quarter earnings that beat analyst estimates by $0.01, though revenue fell short of consensus expectations.
why: Mixed earnings reports with top-line misses often trigger volatility in software and technology sector valuations.
